problem: L01 OPI 3 requires spoken age values, but no historical HNK numeral lexicon or cardinal composition rule was recovered.

recommended_strategy.description: Author one independent spoken CANDIDATE primitive for each cardinal value 0 through 9, then govern multi-digit/cardinal composition in a later gate.
why: 0-9 are semantically atomic beginner concepts and high-frequency language infrastructure.
Independent primitives avoid pretending that an unrecovered HNK base/morphology already exists.
A later composition gate can decide 10, 11, tens and larger values after the primitive inventory is stable.
This keeps age teaching possible without making the numerological architecture dictate lexical form.

alternatives_not_selected.reason: Safe for display bridge only; insufficient for spoken language.
Would infer semantics from structural glyph identity without source evidence.
12 is symbolically important in HNK architecture but no recovered linguistic evidence licenses base-12 numeral grammar.
Explicitly prohibited by the lexeme-authoring contract.

candidate_generation_constraints.preferred_shape: short pronounceable CV/CVCV candidates, subject to collision/confusion review

later_gates: Generate and audit 10 candidate forms only after this strategy is explicitly approved.
Approve/reject each candidate as CANDIDATE; no direct FROZEN entry.
Decide whether an explicit year/age unit is necessary or whether context licenses a bare cardinal response.
Return to L01 OPI 3 whole-slot validation only after a sufficient spoken age answer exists.
application_rule: Do not generate, register or teach numeral forms from this decision record until explicit human approval of the TEN_PRIMITIVE_DIGIT_NUMERALS strategy.
